title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn, Feb 13, 2027
description: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn is an orchestral concert of religious works by great American composers, inviting reflection on the sacred and holy. The program includes Jessie Montgomery's Starburst, Leonard Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, and Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring, built around the Shaker hymn Simple Gifts. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
